title: Atlas
description: This is the first navigation method; more convenient navigation methods will become available later.
- Can be worn in a <property>curio slot</property> to <positive>unlock the minimap</positive>.
- While worn, can be <positive>opened</positive> by using <keyword>\[M\]</keyword>
- When held, the <property>entity radar</property> is enabled

- By pressing <keyword>\[B\]</keyword>, you can <positive>place markers</positive>. You can also press <keyword>\[B\]</keyword> while looking at a <keyword>fire pit</keyword>, <keyword>bed</keyword>, <keyword>banner</keyword> etc. to add them as a marker.
- To display a marker on the minimap, <positive>open the atlas</positive> and press <positive>RMB</positive> on it
- Every <magic>dimension</magic> will have its exclusive map
- You can <warning>lock the atlas</warning> by <positive>shift clicking</positive> it, preventing new maps from being created.
- You can also <positive>place an Atlas on a Lectern</positive> and access the worldmap from there
- §lAtlases can be cloned and merged within a <keyword>Cartography table</keyword>§r
Самый первый способ навигации, в дальнейшем у вас появятся более удобные способы навигации.

- Клавиша <keyword>\[B\]</keyword> - <positive>ставит маркеры</positive>; нажми <keyword>\[B\]</keyword> смотря на <keyword>костёр</keyword>, <keyword>кровать</keyword>, <keyword>баннер</keyword> и т.д. чтобы добавить их как маркер
- Атласы можно <positive>клонировать и объединять</positive> в <keyword>столе картографа</keyword>
